title: Deep learning on breast ultrasound images assists lesion diagnosis in China
summary: A deep learning model was developed on 14,043 images from 5012 women prospectively collected from 32 hospitals; 30 hospitals formed the training (n = 4149) and internal test (n = 466) sets, and two hospitals (n = 397) the external test. External AUC was 0.913 with sensitivity 88.84% and specificity 83.77%; AUC was similar to an expert and above three inexperienced radiologists. Model assistance for readers was also explored; data collection was prospective, but the model was trained and tested on collected data.
ai_technology: Deep learning model for classifying breast ultrasound images

evidence.tested: Internal test cohort and an external test cohort from two held-out hospitals, with comparison against BI-RADS and five radiologists.
evidence.unknown: Performance in other countries and routine use; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies breast lesions as benign or malignant on ultrasound.
